description: Scan a repository and return the full Umbra Trust Score report as JSON (SAFE/CLEAN static findings; deep=true also verifies RUNS and HONEST in a Docker sandbox). Call before declaring a task done — a score below 50 means the work is not done.

deep.description: Also verify RUNS and HONEST in a Docker sandbox (slower, needs Docker)

path.description: (required) Path to the repository to scan
